_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tqeqqilt di Klondike Solitaire. Tawwuri-k wɛrri ad tɛddɛt tifilit n yikarḍi ɣer waddalen n ussɛẓ.

Tawwuri n wari:
- Waddalen n ussɛẓ (F1-F4): Rnu ɣer tifilit n Ace ɣer tifilit n King ɣer wakal
- Waddalen n tɛbili (T1-T7): Rnu ɣer wakal n tɛbili n waran (aẓerɣ ɣef aberkan, aberkan ɣef aẓerɣ)
- Stock: Ssɛẓ tifilit ɣer waddal n waste
- Waste (W): Tifilit n uzwu tɛlla kif-kif ɣer wari

Iwaliwen:
- 'draw' - Ssɛẓ tifilit ɣer waddal n waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Ssɛẓ tifilit ɣer waddalen
  Imedyaten: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count yezmer ad yili 'all', ad yeqqel ad yessɛẓ tifilit akkʷ.
- 'forfeit' - Ffeɣ wari tawwuri-k tura d tɛddɛt tawwuri-k tura
- Isemawen n waddalen: W (waste), F1-F4 (ussɛẓ), T1-T7 (tɛbili)

Tzemreɣ ad teddɛt tawwuri akkʷ di kra n wakud s tɛṣṣifi-nsen s tɛṣṣifi n commas:
  Imedyat: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kan King ad yeqqel ad yili ɣer waddal n tɛbili iɣer.
Tawwuri teddɛt s wakud - ma yella kra n wakud yeqqel, tawwuri tɛddɛt tɛṣṣifi-nsen.
Seqdec 'forfeit' ma tɛẓra wari ur yezmir ad yeqqel.
